references.prompt: A full-body stylized 3D male character for an educational documentary. Simple recognizable design, clean white clothing, expressive face, realistic 3D materials and soft studio lighting. Standing in a neutral pose, facing the camera. Plain light grey background. Professional 3D animation quality. No text or watermark.

A cinematic 3D environment of an ancient village surrounded by a dense green forest. Small wooden houses, natural materials, trees, a dirt pathway and warm morning sunlight. Wide establishing shot. Professional educational documentary visual style. No people, no characters, no text or watermark.

scenes.title: The Beginning
scenes.narration: Long before the modern world existed, a small community lived in the heart of the forest.

shots.description: A wide cinematic establishing shot of the ancient village at sunrise, with golden sunlight filtering through the surrounding forest.
The main character standing on a dirt pathway, looking towards the ancient village.
A closer cinematic shot of the main character walking along the village pathway, surrounded by wooden houses and greenery.

scenes.title: A New Dawn
scenes.narration: As the sun rose above the mountains, the villagers prepared for another day.

shots.description: A beautiful wide shot of the morning sun rising above the forest surrounding the village.
The main character walking through the village as warm morning sunlight illuminates the pathway.
